unlisted_practices: Agent-based (Planner/Memory/Executor) pipeline to clean and structure raw doctor-patient transcripts into training corpora for LLM fine-tuning
Ablation of agent modules (Planner, Memory) to test contribution to transcript reconstruction accuracy
Comparing fine-tuning on structured versus raw transcripts using blinded expert rating and HealthBench

screen.reason: The paper develops and evaluates an agent-based data curation pipeline to preprocess raw clinical audio transcripts for LLM fine-tuning, comparing model architectures rather than organizational deployment safeguards.
